主要内容: President Donald Trump has been engaging in heated exchanges with Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau and French President Emmanuel Macron ahead of the G-7 summit. In a tweet, Trump accused Canada and France of imposing "massive tariffs" and creating "non-monetary barriers." He reiterated his criticism of Canada's trade policies, stating that they have treated American farmers "very poorly for a long period of time." Trump also targeted Canada's dairy industry, claiming it is "killing" U.S. agriculture. Trudeau, in a speech at the Economic Club of New York on May 17, 2018, addressed the relationship between the U.S. and Canada, highlighting the historical ties between the two nations. Tensions between the U.S. and its allies have been heightened after the Trump administration imposed tariffs on imports from Canada, Mexico, and the European Union, citing national security concerns. Canada responded by threatening retaliatory measures, and other countries have also pledged to impose their own retaliatory tariffs. The G-7 summit, hosted in Quebec, will bring together leaders from the U.K., Canada, Japan, Italy, Germany, and France.
